== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Trooper Guard (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Imperial Trooper Guard]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100699 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100699], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100699-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(56, 42, 682, 870)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9030fec6629b8f2d7c828901d3b6ed4affae668281306cc080da3819a4b8b6f1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
